meta.title_en: Too Little Flow and the Foam Gets Stuck
meta.topic: 咖啡拉花 · 流速控制

scenes.title_en: Low Flow: Foam Stuck in Place
scenes.context: 小流量：奶泡卡在原地，一片白色。流量不够，奶泡推不出去，图案就做不出来。语域：咖啡教学，问题演示。
sentences: 小流量，奶泡卡在原地。
With low flow, the foam gets stuck in place.
gets stuck in place（卡在原地）
流不出来，一片白色。
It can't move — just a patch of white.
a patch of white（一片白色）
流量不够，图案就出不来。
Without enough flow, no pattern appears.
no pattern appears（图案出不来）
paraphrase: 奶泡卡住 → foam stuck / the foam freezes
一片白色 → a patch of white / all white
scenes.speak: With low flow, the foam gets stuck in place. It can't move — just a patch of white. Without enough flow, no pattern appears.

scenes.title_en: High Flow: The Impact Pushes It Open
scenes.context: 大流量：冲击力将奶泡推开。增大流量，用冲击力把奶泡推散开，才能画出纹路。语域：咖啡教学，对比演示。
sentences: 大流量，冲击力把奶泡推开。
High flow: the impact pushes the foam open.
pushes the foam open（把奶泡推开）
流量就是推动力。
Flow rate is the driving force.
the driving force（推动力）
流量够，纹路就能画出来。
Enough flow and the lines can be drawn.
lines can be drawn（画纹路）
paraphrase: 冲击力 → the impact / pushing force
scenes.speak: High flow: the impact pushes the foam open. Flow rate is the driving force. Enough flow and the lines can be drawn.

scenes.title_en: High Flow Plus Swing: Lines Spread Out
scenes.context: 大流量加摆动：纹路向四周扩散。流量管扩散，摆动管花纹，组合起来纹路清晰向四周展开。语域：咖啡教学，进阶演示。
sentences: 大流量加摆动，纹路向四周扩散。
High flow plus swinging spreads the lines outward.
spreads outward（向四周扩散）
流量管扩散，摆动管花纹。
Flow spreads; swinging shapes the pattern.
shapes the pattern（管花纹）
两者结合，拉花就出来了。
Combined, the latte art appears.
the latte art appears（拉花出来了）
paraphrase: 纹路扩散 → lines spread / the pattern radiates
拉花 → latte art / the poured design
scenes.speak: High flow plus swinging spreads the lines outward. Flow spreads; swinging shapes the pattern. Combined, the latte art appears.

practice: With low flow, the foam gets stuck in place.
High flow: the impact pushes the foam open.
High flow plus swinging spreads the lines outward.
pitfalls: The milk foam is stuck in the cup.
The foam gets stuck in place.
「一片白色」用 a patch of white。
The impact pushes the foam open.
「冲击力推开」用 the impact pushes open。
「拉花出来了」用 the latte art appears。
shifts: 用 gets stuck in place（卡住）、a patch of white（一片白）、the impact pushes open（冲击力推开）
用 flow rate（流速）、the driving force（推动力）、high flow（大流量）
用 spreads outward（向四周扩散）、lines can be drawn（画纹路）、latte art（拉花）
footer_notes: 本视频无口播转录，场景数据基于图文实录图片说明（figcaption）重建。已校正：小流量奶泡卡住、大流量冲击推开、大流量加摆动纹路扩散等。
